correctness.rationale: Exhaustive exact verifier proves finite clique and link enumeration, connected nonorientable pseudomanifold with 29 Klein vertex links. Signed dual incidence matrix tree elimination forces integral Smith factors 1 repeated 202 times and 2 once. Separate exact integral cycle lattice elimination has 175 unimodular unit pivots yielding \(H_1=0\); the split homological short exact sequence yields \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z^{28}\oplus\mathbb Z/2\). Independent ranks mod 2 are (28,175,202). All premises, incidence signs and quantifiers were rechecked on the supplied standalone script.

value.rationale: Paley-29 is a natural strongly regular finite-field graph and the radius-one Rips complex is canonical. Klein-bottle links at each of 29 transitive vertices and integral order-two torsion give a substantive local/global topology phenomenon; characteristic-two persistence differs from characteristic-zero persistence. Full exact finite certificate is independently reproducible; the object and invariant are intrinsically motivated rather than arbitrary chosen coordinates.
